usageGuidelines: Join returned rows to Mirror Pulse or ATLAS-7 artifacts by source_date plus ticker or CIK.
Do not expect raw CompanyFacts arrays in this response; request a drilldown by fact_source_pointer/evidence_hash when raw proof is needed.
Use offset/limit to page the full crypto issuer universe instead of attaching a large payload to chat.

description: Use this read-only tool to retrieve compact SEC CompanyFacts/XBRL materialization rows for the crypto public-company universe or a specific ticker/CIK. It returns one compact row per issuer for a materialized companyfacts source_date, including tag counts, crypto/digital-asset flags, top tags, taxonomies, evidence hashes, and fact source pointers. Parameters: source_date replays a known YYYY-MM-DD materialization slice; ticker or cik optionally narrows to one issuer; limit defaults to 25 and is capped at 250; offset paginates the universe. Behavior: read-only and idempotent; it performs no writes, has no destructive side effects, and never returns the raw facts_payload, so use fact_source_pointer plus evidence_hash for drilldown/audit. Use this for Mirror Pulse or ATLAS-7 historical joins when you need the compact issuer-level CompanyFacts inventory for all 215 crypto companies.

cik.description: Optional SEC CIK. Accepts bare digits or CIK-prefixed form and normalizes to 10 digits.

include_summary.description: Include the compact summary JSON object in each row.

limit.description: Maximum issuer rows to return. Defaults to 25 and is capped at 250.

mode.description: Optional response mode. Use compact by default; summary includes the compact summary object.

offset.description: Pagination offset over compact issuer rows.

source_date.description: Optional materialized CompanyFacts source date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the latest materialized source date.

ticker.description: Optional public-company ticker. Omit with cik to page the full materialized crypto issuer universe.
